column1: # LDV Passenger Vehicle Parameters for ideea_vehicle()
# All efficiency values are PLACEHOLDERS — calibrate from BNVFE reference data
#   fuels            : "|"-separated fuel commodity names (must exist in repository)
#   primary_fuel     : fuel used for energy-content lookup (volumetric eff_units)
#   blend_fuel       : optional secondary/blend fuel name (leave blank if none)
#   blend_share_up   : max blend fraction [0-1] (ignored if blend_fuel is blank)
#   eff_unit         : one of: L/100km | mpg | mpg_uk | km/kWh | kWh/100km | BTU/mi | MJ/km | PJ/MPKm
#   avg_km_yr        : average annual km per vehicle
#   capacity_units   : vehicles per model capacity unit (default 1000)
#   share_hwy_up     : max fraction of activity on highway [0-1]
#   share_cty_up     : max fraction of activity in city    [0-1]
#   annual_cost_usd  : annual maintenance/running cost per vehicle [USD/year]
#   image_file       : path to vehicle image (relative to project root)
